nōmĭnātōrĭus , a, um, adj. nominator,
I.of or belonging to naming, naming, containing names (in jurid. Lat.): nominatorii breves, Cod. Th. 1, 10, 8; “11, 28, 3: pericula,” having a name, named, Tert. Anim. 13 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
